backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining server hosting platform types (ServerPlan, Order, Invoice, ShoppingCart, etc.), storage maps, admin/user management with AccessControl mixin, CRUD operations for plans/orders/invoices, custom server pricing logic, Stripe checkout integration, and seed data initialization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the infinite loop fix in AdminSetupNotice component, listing affected files (AdminSetupNotice.tsx, useQueries.ts), related components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and documentation, highlighting admin setup flow, unified isCallerAdmin checks, infinite loop prevention, and migration fixes.
frontend/ADMIN_SETUP_FAULT_LIST.md: Developer documentation cataloging three known admin setup faults: infinite loop on fresh deployment due to stale adminAssigned flag, inconsistent admin state between queries, and profile modal flashing before admin assignment, with symptoms, causes, fixes, and debugging steps.
frontend/FRONTEND_FILE_TREE.md: Comprehensive developer reference documenting all frontend files and directories with descriptions, purposes, read-only vs editable flags, and quick navigation to admin setup flow entrypoints.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script tag for mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, plans, dashboard, admin, and payment status pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AdminSetupNotice: Alert banner component that auto-assigns admin to first authenticated user, now preventing infinite reload loops by tracking permanent errors and removing automatic page refresh on 'admin already exists' errors.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright notice and caffeine.ai attribution link with heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header component with logo, menu links (Home, Plans, Dashboard, Admin), shopping cart icon with badge, and authentication button. Includes mobile responsive menu using Sheet component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that renders Header, Footer, AdminSetupNotice, ProfileSetupModal, and an Outlet for nested routes with a container for main content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name and email. Prevents closing until profile is created.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: Controlled modal dialog for configuring Stripe payment settings including secret key and allowed countries (comma-separated). Submits configuration via mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication identity. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes and initializes access control with admin token from URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including server plans, user profiles, shopping cart, orders, invoices, Stripe configuration, admin checks, and custom server configs. Each mutation invalidates relevant query caches.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, plus a grid pattern utility for hero sections.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page for managing server plans, viewing orders and users, and configuring Stripe payment settings. Requires authentication and admin privileges to access.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page displaying shopping cart, orders, and invoices with functionality to manage cart items and initiate Stripe checkout. Requires user authentication.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section showcasing dedicated server offerings and feature cards highlighting server benefits like root access, performance, and security.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page displayed after unsuccessful Stripe checkout, providing options to return to cart or browse plans.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success page displayed after successful Stripe checkout, clears the cart and provides navigation to dashboard or plans.
frontend/src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: Server plans catalog page displaying available predefined plans and a custom server configurator with dynamic pricing calculation. Allows authenticated users to add plans to cart.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking an infinite loop bug in AdminSetupNotice component where 'An admin already exists' error causes continuous page refreshes, with pending investigation into the root cause.
